topic.angle: ESCAPADE twins launched Nov 13 2025 when Earth and Mars were on opposite sides of the Sun; a year-long kidney-bean loiter orbit around L2 (~1 million mi), magnetotail passes; powered Earth flybys Nov 7 (~1,000 mi, ~9-min burn) and Nov 9 2026 (~650 mi); first NASA powered Earth flyby to Mars; Mars orbit insertion Sept 7/9 2027.
